# Download CV illustration — v1

Generated with the built-in `image_gen` tool on 9 October 2026. The original PNG retains transparent alpha; the 80/160 px WebP variants only resize and encode it. Used as a decorative 32 px image in the native CV download link, on desktop and in the mobile menu. The visible label remains “Download CV”.

## Final prompt

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a standalone Download CV icon for Aleix's developer portfolio navigation. Subject: a thick ivory-white resume document with a folded top-right corner and a prominent emerald-green downward download arrow at the lower-right, ending above a simple shallow download tray. One unified, compact sculptural object. The document has only a simple raised circular profile mark and two broad recessed horizontal lines, no tiny details. No lettering or words: the button provides the Download CV text. Style: polished low-poly 3D with broad visible triangular polygon facets, matte surfaces, softly bevelled edges, warm upper-left studio light, soft self-shadowing, friendly sculptural quality matching a faceted chibi developer avatar and existing matte 3D social icons. Near-frontal restrained three-quarter view, about 12 degrees yaw and 8 degrees downward view. Emerald accent close to #38C188; warm ivory document, subtle neutral-gray faceted edges. The downward arrow must be clearly readable at 40 pixels, with a thick straight shaft and bold triangular arrowhead; simple bold silhouette and strong contrast. Center the whole object on a square canvas, occupying about 85% of the canvas, equal transparent breathing room. Genuine transparent RGBA background; no floor, no solid backdrop, no checkerboard drawn into the image, no external cast shadow. Keep the complete object inside the canvas. Avoid additional objects, scenery, human characters, logos, watermarks, glossy glass, metallic chrome and microtext.
